items.summary: Disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, and security-sensitive release; conditional for ordinary reversible growth within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: compliance baseline is technical only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown; analytics and revenue attribution are yellow; operations and fleet-security sweeps have no results; Amazon's $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 is aggregate and unattributed. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution, keep private launch gates closed, permit only existing bounded evidence, repair, measurement, attribution, and parked-site work, and make no unsupported revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal-lift claims. Human counsel is required for rights-dependent launch, privacy/jurisdiction questions, and future affiliate or advertising use.

SearchWoot launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing evidence includes official Woot documentation, public terms, support documentation, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft public terms. No task is closable because rights, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, and incident procedures remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix. Keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Retain complicated.work parked: it is reachable but fails banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 checks; next evidence action is isolated remediation followed by the same compliance rerun. Retain deadlymaracas.com parked: DNS fetch failed and reachability, compliance, analytics, monetization, and launch evidence are unknown; next evidence action is a dated reachability, disclosure, consent, analytics, terms, monetization, and explicit launch-decision checklist. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth, but failed or unknown compliance gates remain site-specific blockers.

Continue the existing SearchWoot evidence work only. Produce the consolidated read-only bundle covering source fields and rights, data flow, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendors, incident handling, accuracy/freshness, and rollback. Do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, or launch state.

Maintain the private launch gate. Security evidence remains unavailable for fleet-doctor, operations sweeps, authentication, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, TLS, monitoring, incident, and disclosure controls. Continue only the existing bounded read-only evidence matrix; do not access credentials or private containers, alter permissions, add dependencies, deploy, exploit, or conduct outreach.
